# Isaiah Chapter 53 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 12 verses]*

*Despised and rejected; man of sorrows; bore our griefs; like a lamb to slaughter; by his wounds healed*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** He was pierced for our transgressions; he was crushed for our iniquities. This chapter despised and rejected.

*-- LOGOS*
